structured_output.summary: POST /links is now limited to 10 requests per 60s per client IP (req.socket.remoteAddress). The 11th returns 429 {"error":"rate limited"} with a whole-second retry-after (rounded up, at least 1). The window is fixed and starts at the client's first request, and every POST /links counts, including 400s. The check runs before the body is read, so limited requests never call randomSlug or create a link. State is a per-createApp() Map that uses the injected now(), and expired entries are pruned. Other routes are untouched. New test/rate-limit.test.js covers the 429 and retry-after values (60, 30, 1), 400s counting, reset after 60s, other routes exempt while limited, per-instance state, and separate IPs (via 127.0.0.2, skipped if that address can't be bound). npm test passes: 10 tests, 0 failures.
